full_prompt_en: A square painterly landscape looks across an industrial town at dusk, where a single chimney sends a dark plume diagonally into a yellow-gray sky. The upper half is active with layered stormy brushwork: blue-green and charcoal sweeps crowd the top, a pale gray band spreads across the left, and a patch of glowing mustard yellow opens above the distant horizon on the right. Near the center-left, the thin chimney rises from a broad field of low brown and gray buildings. Smoke leaves its top and widens as it crosses toward the upper right, becoming one of the strongest directional shapes. In the middle distance, ochre walls, flat roofs, and occasional pale windows are loosely indicated rather than individually detailed. At center-right, a tall narrow dark tree stands in front of the town, its nearly black silhouette cutting through the luminous sky. Below it, a small green enclosed area sits behind a warm brick-colored wall. The lower left contains a dark sloping roof or railway structure, and the lower center-right has a narrow road with a tiny vehicle moving beside the wall. Sparse bare trees appear near the bottom edge. The composition is built from rubbed and broken oil strokes, with softened distances and a few decisive vertical marks. Warm amber light appears to break through the cloud from the right, touching some walls and the edge of the sky, while the roofs and foreground remain in blue-green shadow. The plume is darker than the surrounding cloud and casts a foreboding diagonal over the town. No readable text is visible. The overall composition is subdued yet dramatic, balancing the glowing horizon and warm masonry against the heavy smoke, tall dark tree, and cool descending foreground.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形绘画式风景越过暮色工业城镇望去，一根烟囱把深色烟柱斜送进金灰色天空。上半部有活跃的暴风般笔触：蓝绿和炭色扫笔挤满上沿，浅灰云带铺向左侧，右边远处地平线上方则打开一片发亮的芥黄色。中央偏左，细烟囱从宽阔低矮的棕灰房屋群中升起。烟从顶部离开，向右上越过画面时变宽，成为最强的方向形状之一。中远处，赭色墙、平屋顶和偶尔出现的浅窗以松笔提示，没有逐栋细刻。中央偏右，一棵高窄深树立在城镇前，近黑剪影切过明亮天空。树下，一小片围合的绿地藏在暖砖色墙后。左下方有深色斜屋顶或铁路结构，下方中央偏右，一条窄路上有一辆小车沿墙而行。底边附近出现稀疏裸树。构图由擦磨和断续油画笔触建立，远景柔化，只有少数决定性竖痕。暖琥珀光似从右边云层间破出，碰到部分墙面与天空边缘，屋顶和前景则留在蓝绿影里。烟柱比周围云更暗，以令人不安的斜线压过城镇。没有可读文字。整体构图低调却戏剧化，发亮地平线与暖砖墙对抗沉重烟云、高暗树和下行的冷色前景。
style_prompt_en: This expressive oil-paint treatment builds atmosphere from rubbed, broken strokes and broad directional cloudlike masses. Muted ochre, brick brown, yellow-gold, slate, blue-green, and charcoal trade dominance across the frame; a warm opening glows inside a much larger cool dark field. Distant forms are compressed into low horizontal bands, while a few thin black verticals and one strong diagonal organize the space. Edges soften with haze except at selected silhouettes, and the foreground holds rough, shadowed texture. Light is low and indirect, touching isolated planes while much of the scene stays subdued. The overall effect is somber, tactile, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种富表现力的油画处理以擦磨断笔和宽阔有方向的云状大块建立空气感。暗赭、砖棕、金黄、石板色、蓝绿和炭色在画面中交替主导；大片冷暗色域内打开一处暖光。远处形体压缩成低矮水平带，少量细黑竖线与一道强烈斜线组织空间。除选定剪影外，边缘随雾气柔化，前景保留粗糙阴影肌理。光低而间接，只触碰孤立平面，其余大部保持低调。整体效果阴郁、有触感，并带安静的戏剧性。
theme_en: An industrial town under a smoke-darkened golden sky
theme_zh: 烟云压向金色天空的工业城镇
name: Arturo Souto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
